name: AL-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a 17-point partisan lean
Incumbent Gary Palmer running with a large fundraising edge
Democratic challenger has raised almost nothing
Prediction markets price Republican win at 96%
model.rationale: This is a heavily Republican Birmingham-area district where Palmer holds a massive financial advantage and the Democratic challenger has raised under $7,000. Markets price a Republican win at 96%, and no polls or expert ratings suggest any reason to move from the fundamentals.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or Palmer's retirement would be the only realistic path to competitive status.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Alabama's 6th District is a solidly Republican seat centered on Birmingham's suburbs, with a partisan lean of about 17 points toward Republicans. Incumbent Gary Palmer is running for another term and has raised over $1 million, holding a large cash advantage. His Democratic challenger, Maurice Mercer, has raised only a few thousand dollars and has no outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings are available for this race, but prediction markets give Palmer roughly a 96% chance of winning. The combination of the district's strong Republican lean, Palmer's incumbency, and the challenger's minimal resources makes this a Safe Republican race with little realistic prospect of a competitive contest.
